scale.description: Indicative nightly and weekly accommodation ranges per base for August 2026, derived from the research corpus and aggregator snapshots. The family's target nightly budget is €150 (ceiling €180). Live availability for both date windows still needs a Booking.com check.

facts.label: Saint-Malo / Dinan
facts.officialSource: Research corpus ranges (not a live Booking quote)
facts.notes: Sources disagree on price (high vs lower range); budget toward the higher range inside the walls or near the Sillon. Book well ahead — August is peak. Research-range estimate only — re-sample live Booking.com rates before booking.

facts.label: Côte de Granit Rose
facts.officialSource: Research corpus ranges (not a live Booking quote)
facts.notes: Somewhat cheaper than Saint-Malo; sea-view and stone-cottage properties carry a steep premium. Research-range estimate only — re-sample live Booking.com rates before booking.

facts.label: Brest / Finistère
facts.officialSource: Research corpus ranges (not a live Booking quote)
facts.notes: Best value of the shortlist; a 3-star family room quoted around €70–90/night. Research-range estimate only — re-sample live Booking.com rates before booking.

facts.label: Quimper / South Finistère
facts.officialSource: Research corpus ranges (not a live Booking quote)
facts.notes: Gentle budget option; gîtes €300–700/week. Some aggregators show August rates dipping below June. Research-range estimate only — re-sample live Booking.com rates before booking.

facts.label: Crozon / Douarnenez
facts.officialSource: Research corpus ranges (not a live Booking quote)
facts.notes: Between Brest value and coastal-resort pricing; gîtes €380–900/week. Research-range estimate only — re-sample live Booking.com rates before booking.

facts.label: Vannes / Carnac / Morbihan
facts.officialSource: Research corpus ranges (not a live Booking quote)
facts.notes: Most expensive zone after Saint-Malo, especially by the sea. A 5-star campsite (La Grande Métairie) runs €1,400–2,200/week. Research-range estimate only — re-sample live Booking.com rates before booking.
